name: goal-refresh
description: Keeps a session's standing goal (and the native /goal condition) fresh in long sessions by re-injecting a short reminder on turns already happening, and lets the goal be updated through discussion (goal_update tool, /goal-refresh).

everyTurns.title: Refresh every N turns
everyTurns.description: Re-inject the goal reminder after this many main-thread turns since the last one. 0 turns this trigger off.

afterCompact.title: Refresh after compaction
afterCompact.description: Re-inject the goal reminder at the first chance after the main conversation is compacted.

minIntervalMinutes.title: Refresh after this many minutes
minIntervalMinutes.description: Re-inject the goal reminder once this many minutes have passed since the last one (at least one turn in between). 0 turns this trigger off.

mirrorNativeGoal.title: Include the native /goal condition
mirrorNativeGoal.description: Read the active /goal stop condition from the session transcript and include it in the reminder and status line.

nativeReadMinutes.title: Re-read the transcript after this many minutes
nativeReadMinutes.description: Once a native /goal has been seen, a main-thread turn re-reads the transcript for it at most this often; a compaction, a resume, /goal, SetGoal and each reminder read it at once. 0 reads on every turn.

showStatus.title: Show the goal in the status line
showStatus.description: Show a truncated goal in the status line while one is set.

showToasts.title: Show toasts
showToasts.description: Show a toast with the old and new goal each time the model updates it.

systemNotifications.title: System notifications
systemNotifications.description: Also send a macOS notification each time the model updates the goal.
